after.backend/payments/validate.ts:
const CURRENCIES = ['CAD', 'USD', 'EUR']

export function validateCharge(req: { amountCents: number, currency: string, cardToken: string }): string | null {
  if (!Number.isInteger(req.amountCents) || req.amountCents <= 0) return 'Amount must be a positive number of cents'
  if (req.amountCents > 1_000_000) return 'Amount is over the 10,000 limit'
  if (!CURRENCIES.includes(req.currency.toUpperCase())) return `Unsupported currency: ${req.currency}`
  if (!req.cardToken?.startsWith('pm_')) return 'Invalid card token'
  return null
}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { validateCharge } from './validate'
+
+const ok = { amountCents: 2500, currency: 'CAD', cardToken: 'pm_card_visa' }
+
+describe('validateCharge', () => {
+  it('accepts a normal charge', () => expect(validateCharge(ok)).toBeNull())
+  it('rejects zero and negative amounts', () => {
+    expect(validateCharge({ ...ok, amountCents: 0 })).toMatch(/positive/)
+    expect(validateCharge({ ...ok, amountCents: -5 })).toMatch(/positive/)
+  })
+  it('rejects unsupported currencies', () => expect(validateCharge({ ...ok, currency: 'XYZ' })).toMatch(/Unsupported/))
+  it('rejects bad card tokens', () => expect(validateCharge({ ...ok, cardToken: 'card_1' })).toMatch(/card token/))
+})
